summary: Backend: wrote pytest suite (20 tests) covering all 7 new Friends-hub/compare endpoints + 4 negative paths. Result: 20/20 PASSED (1 skipped — admin's only friend has no shared landmarks, so the compare-landmark happy-path could not be exercised on real data). All leaderboard metrics (points|landmarks|destinations|continents) return correctly sorted rows with sequential ranks and is_me flag. shared-places, activity, group-stats (max-4 enforcement), compare-stats, overlap/countries, compare/landmarks all return the expected shape. 403 enforcement on non-friend and 404 on missing landmark both verified. Non-private visit leak verified defensively. Frontend: /friends route loads cleanly unauthenticated (old empty-state shell — Find Friends + My Friends(0) + bottom tab bar), no pageerrors or crashes, just the expected 401 on data fetches. Authenticated web login is still flaky via RN Paper TextInput (same blocker as iteration_20), so the NEW hub layout (Crew carousel, Who's Leading, Shared Places strip, Activity Feed, Group mode) and /compare/[lid]/[fid] page could not be visually exercised end-to-end on web. Component code and backend powering them both verified present + functional.

integration_issues.issue: Same as iteration_20: RN Paper TextInput doesn't expose a stable native input for Playwright fill, so scripted authenticated UI flows (friends hub, group mode, compare page) could not be executed on web. Not a user-visible bug on native; only affects web E2E harness.

critical_code_review_comments: friends.py line 3: `from fastapi import Query` is the ONLY explicit fastapi import in this module; everything else (APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException) comes in via `from ._social_common import *`. A previous reload transiently errored NameError: Query not defined — confirm _social_common doesn't accidentally shadow/remove Query in future refactors.

friends.py _user_stats uses $addToSet on country_name and continent but filters None with `[c for c in stats['continents'] if c]` AFTER aggregation — if a user has visits to landmarks missing country/continent metadata, counts could understate. Consider $match out null in pipeline for determinism.

/api/friends/group-stats does NOT enforce a lower bound (0 user_ids is allowed and returns just 'me'). That's probably fine but worth documenting; also max=4 means 'max 4 friends' but the request-parsed list can contain the caller's own id (not explicitly rejected), inflating the effective group size to 5.

/api/compare/landmarks/.../friends/... permission check runs BEFORE landmark existence check, so a non-friend probing for landmarks gets 403 instead of 404 — correct (prevents enumeration leak). Confirm this is intentional (it is, per test_compare_landmark_403_non_friend passing).
test_credentials.md is stale — points to wrong user_ids. Any test agent that hard-codes those IDs will fail (as this run initially did). Single source of truth should be refreshed from /api/auth/me.

rca of the issue: Initial 5/21 test failures were NOT product bugs — they were caused by stale /app/memory/test_credentials.md claiming admin is friends with testpro when in fact admin's only accepted friend is Social Tester. After refactoring fixtures to auto-discover admin's first friend via GET /api/friends (instead of hardcoding testpro_id), all gated tests passed. Mitigation: keep test_credentials.md authoritative by deriving user_ids live from /api/auth/me in fixtures.
